programme.title: Stravinsky - Le sacre du printemps
programme.desc: Maestro Bernard Haitink leads the Berliner Philharmoniker in a performance of Igor Stravinsky's Le sacre du printemps (‘The Rite of Spring’). Stravinksy composed the ballet’s score in 1913 for Sergei Diaghilev's itinerant ballet company Ballets Russes. This performance was recorded at the Royal Albert Hall in London, UK, as part of Europakonzert 1993. Maestro Bernard Haitink leads the Berliner Philharmoniker in a performance of Igor Stravinsky's Le sacre du printemps (‘The Rite of Spring’). Stravinksy composed the ballet’s score in 1913 for Sergei Diaghilev's itinerant ballet company Ballets Russes. The work’s sensational première at the Théâtre des Champs-Élysées in Paris caused a riot in the audience in response to the avant-garde nature of the music and choreography. The score, written for one of Stravinsky’s largest orchestras, features harsh dissonances and complex rhythms. Despite its scandalous premiere, the work gained great critical acclaim. Le sacre du printemps is now considered one of the great masterpieces in classical music history, which influenced many 20th-century composers. This performance was recorded at the Royal Albert Hall in London, UK, as part of Europakonzert 1993.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Semi-finals: Schubert, Wolf a. o.
programme.desc: Soprano Heidi Baumgartner (Austria, 1998) and pianist Asuka Tagami (Japan, 1991) perform works by Franz Schubert, Hugo Wolf, Bart Visman, Kaija Saariaho, and Claude Debussy, during the semi-finals of the International Vocal Competition 2021 - Lied Duo. This performance was recorded at Het Noordbrabants Museum in ’s-Hertogenbosch, the Netherlands. Soprano Heidi Baumgartner (Austria, 1998) and pianist Asuka Tagami (Japan, 1991) perform Franz Schubert’s Suleika I, Op. 14 No. 1, D. 720; ‘Er ist’s’ from Hugo Wolf’s Mörike-Lieder; Bart Visman’s Vermeer’s Gold; ‘Sua katselen’ (Looking at you) from Kaija Saariaho’s Leino-Laulut (Leino songs); and ‘Pantomime’ and ‘Apparition’ from Claude Debussy’s Quatre chansons de jeunesse, during the semi-finals of the International Vocal Competition 2021 - Lied Duo. This performance was recorded at Het Noordbrabants Museum in ’s-Hertogenbosch, the Netherlands.

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Concerto No. 27, KV 595
programme.desc: Soloist Aleksander Madzar and the Royal Philharmonic Orchestra directed by Andre Previn join forces in a performance of Mozart's Piano Concerto No. 27, KV 595, recorded at Vienna's Schönbrunn palace. Soloist Aleksander Madzar and the Royal Philharmonic Orchestra directed by Andre Previn join forces in a performance of Mozart's Piano Concerto No. 27, KV 595, recorded at Vienna's Schönbrunn palace. In 1791, with his life cruelly and rapidly ending, Mozart once again turned to the compositional style which reflected his personality: the concerto for piano and orchestra. His last piano concerto, which turned out to be an uplifting composition, regales its audience with a lyrical children's song, invoking the joys of youth and springtime.

programme.title: Debussy - La Mer
programme.desc: Claude Debussy’s symphonic sketches for orchestra known collectively as ‘La Mer’ evoke a richly varied vision of the sea. This concert in Philharmonie Köln, Cologne is played by the Chicago Symphony Orchestra and Daniel Barenboim. Claude Debussy’s symphonic sketches for orchestra known collectively as ‘La Mer’ evoke a richly varied vision of the sea. The first part (‘De l’aube á midi sur la mer’) calls up a morning and afternoon at sea, the second (‘Jeux de vagues’) echoes the play of the waves, and the third and final part (‘Dialogue du vent et de la mer’) conjures the communing voices of wind and waves. Debussy knew his sea, the Mediterranean, intimately both from childhood visits to Cannes and from his Italian travels later in life.

programme.title: Muskens performs sonatas by Franz Ignaz Beck
programme.desc: Every year at the end of August the renowned Early Music Festival takes place in the Dutch city of Utrecht. s part of this festival, Canadian fortepianist Anders Muskens performs a recital consisting of various sonatas by the German Baroque composer Franz Ignaz Beck, such as L’Éveillée and La Sophie. This performance was recorded at the Gertrudiskapel in Utrecht, August 25, 2020. Every year at the end of August the renowned Early Music Festival takes place in the Dutch city of Utrecht. It is the largest festival focused on early music in the world, attracting an audience of more than 70,000 visitors. Due to the COVID-19 pandemic, the 2020 edition of the festival offered an alternative program that included both live concerts on location and daily livestreams of concerts and archival recordings. As part of this festival, Canadian fortepianist Anders Muskens performs a recital consisting of various sonatas by the German Baroque composer Franz Ignaz Beck, such as L’Éveillée and La Sophie. This performance was recorded at the Gertrudiskapel in Utrecht, August 25, 2020.

programme.title: IVC 2019 - Final: Schubert, Wolf et al.
programme.desc: Soprano Erika Baikoff (United States, 1994) and pianist Gary Beecher (Ireland, 1993) perform works by Franz Schubert, Hugo Wolf, Gabriel Fauré, Francis Poulenc, Lili Boulanger, Johanna Bordewijk-Roepman, and Sergei Rachmaninoff, during the final round of the International Vocal Competition 2019 - Lied Duo. This performance was recorded at Theater aan de Parade in ‘s-Hertogenbosch, the Netherlands. Soprano Erika Baikoff (United States, 1994) and pianist Gary Beecher (Ireland, 1993) perform Franz Schubert’s ‘Suleika I, Was bedeutet die Bewegung’, Op. 14, No. 1 (D. 720); Die Blumensprache, Op. 173, No. 5 (D. 519); and, Die Gebüsche, D. 646; ‘Lied vom Winde’ and ‘Der Knabe und das Immlein’ from Hugo Wolf’s Mörike-Lieder; ‘Fleur jetée’ from Gabriel Fauré’s Quatre melodies, Op. 39; ‘C’ from Francis Poulenc’s Deux poèmes de Louis Aragon, FP 122; ‘Les lilas qui avaient fleuri’ from Lili Boulanger’s Clairières dans le ciel; Johanna Bordewijk-Roepman’s ‘Oranje may-lied’; and, ‘Eti letniye nochi’ (These summer nights) from Sergei Rachmaninoff’s Twelve romances, Op. 14, during the final round of the International Vocal Competition 2019 - Lied Duo. This performance was recorded at Theater aan de Parade in ‘s-Hertogenbosch, the Netherlands.

programme.title: Israel Philharmonic Orchestra: Coming Home
programme.desc: On the occasion of its 75th anniversary on the 24th of December, 2011, the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra celebrates with a beautiful documentary about the orchestra and it's maestro's. On December 24, 2011, one of the world’s most renowned classical orchestras, the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra, celebrated the 75th anniversary of its founding. The film portrays the orchestra and its eventful history against the backdrop of Israel and the holocaust. Interwoven with individual biographies and archival footage, the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra’s 75 years of history are brought back to life in concerts featuring Arturo Toscanini, Arthur Rubinstein, Leonard Bernstein, Isaac Stern, Zubin Mehta, Daniel Barenboim and Itzhak Perlman. We also get the opportunity to watch the Israel Philharmonic in rehearsals, concerts and on tour

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Sonata No. 32, Op. 111
programme.desc: Tom Beghin’s new recording of Beethoven’s Piano Sonatas Opus 109, 110, and 111 is an artistic exploration of how Beethoven’s musicking was shaped by the work environment he created with the help of colleagues and friends. Not only does pianist Tom Beghin perform Beethoven’s trilogy of pianistic masterpieces on a magnificent new replica of Beethoven’s Broadwood piano, he uses a reconstruction of the Gehörmaschine that was mounted on the composer’s piano so he could continue to create music as his hearing declined.

programme.title: Rachmaninov - Suite No. 1, Op. 5 - IV. Easter
programme.desc: In this splendid concert, exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff, and Nikolai Kapustin. Both pianists, laureates of the prestigious International Tchaikovsky Competition in 1994, have received international recognition. This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on November 25, 2021. In this splendid concert, exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a program for two pianos comprising works of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, Maurice Ravel, Anton Arensky, Sergei Rachmaninoff, and Nikolai Kapustin. Both pianists, laureates of the prestigious International Tchaikovsky Competition in 1994, have received international recognition. They perform regularly in a duo. On the program: Mozart’s Sonata for two pianos in D major, K. 448/375 A; Ravel’s La Valse (arr. for two pianos); Arensky’s Suite No. 1 for two pianos, Op. 15; and Rachmaninoff’s Suite No. 1 (Fantasy) for two pianos, Op. 5. As an encore, the duo performs ‘Romance’ from Rachmaninoff’s Suite No. 2 for two pianos, Op. 17, followed by ‘Overture’ from Nikolai Kapustin’s Sinfonietta, Op. 49. This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on November 25, 2021.

programme.title: Slatkin conducts Bolcom, Beethoven & Ravel
programme.desc: American conductor Leonard Slatkin leads the Orchestre National de Lyon in a concert recorded at the Auditorium de Lyon in 2014. The concert opens with William Bolcom´s Circus Ouverture, which was specially composed for Slatkin's 70th birthday. The concert continues with a performance of Beethoven's Triple Concerto in C, Op. 56 American conductor Leonard Slatkin leads the Orchestre National de Lyon in a concert recorded at the Auditorium de Lyon in 2014. The concert opens with William Bolcom´s Circus Ouverture, which was specially composed for Slatkin's 70th birthday. The concert continues with a performance of Beethoven's Triple Concerto in C, Op. 56 performed by three female soloists: Olga Kern (piano), Baibe Skride (violin) and Sol Gabetta (cello). The work is the only concerto which Beethoven ever completed for more than one solo instrument. The concert closes with Ravel's beloved orchestration of Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition.

programme.desc: In the musical film My Heart Is Burning, René Pape sings and plays various roles that showcase the impressive versatility of his voice and the many facets of his personality. Directed by Sibylle Muth. René Pape perfectly embodies the new generation of opera singers: with a current and relaxed appearance, he craves new challenges and demonstrates an openness to ambitious experimentation. In the musical film My Heart Is Burning, René Pape sings and plays various roles that showcase the impressive versatility of his voice and the many facets of his personality. programme.title: Beethoven-String Quartet No. 14, Op. 131
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music. This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven’s String Quartet No. 2 in G major, Op. 18, No. 2; String Quartet No. 16 in F major, Op. 135; and String Quartet No. 14 in C-sharp minor, Op. 131. This concert was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on December 16, 2020.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 1 in G minor, Op. 13
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen leads Sinfonia Rotterdam in a performance of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s Symphony No. 1 in G minor, Op. 13, ‘Winter Daydreams’, recorded at De Doelen in Rotterdam, the Netherlands in September 2022. Conrad van Alphen leads Sinfonia Rotterdam in a performance of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s Symphony No. 1 in G minor, Op. 13, ‘Winter Daydreams’, recorded at De Doelen in Rotterdam, the Netherlands in September 2022. Having completed a number of shorter orchestral works, Tchaikovsky embarked on a more ambitious project in March 1866: to write his first symphony. In the summer of that year, the young composer showed his still-unfinished score to his former teachers Anton Rubinstein and Nikolai Zaremba, whose harsh criticism thoroughly disillusioned him. With significant changes, the entire symphony was first performed in 1868, but Tchaikovsky further revised the work in 1874. Not only did the composer subtitle his symphony ‘Winter Daydreams’, he used descriptive titles for the first two of the four movements as well: ‘Dreams of a Winter Journey’ and ‘Land of Desolation, Land of Mists’.

programme.title: Rina Sala Gallo Piano Competition 2022 - Finalists
programme.desc: The Rina Sala Gallo International Piano Competition takes place every two years in the Italian city of Monza. This broadcast featuring the three finalists’ best performances from the competition’s 26th edition, were recorded at the Villa Reale di Monza in October 2022. The finalists are Young Sun Choi (South Korea, 1991), Seunghyuk Na (South Korea, 1997), and Ivan Bašić (Serbia, 1996). The Rina Sala Gallo International Piano Competition takes place every two years in the Italian city of Monza. Founded in 1947 by Monza-born pianist Rina Sala Gallo and Brescia-born pianist Arturo Benedetti Michelangeli, the competition is one of Monza’s most prestigious cultural events today. This broadcast featuring the three finalists’ best performances from the competition’s 26th edition, were recorded at the Villa Reale di Monza in October 2022. First, Young Sun Choi (South Korea, 1991) performs Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Sonata No. 30 in E major, Op. 106. After, Seunghyuk Na (South Korea, 1997) plays ‘Oiseaux tristes’ and ‘Alborada del gracioso’ from Maurice Ravel’s five-movement suite Miroirs. Next, Ivan Bašić (Serbia, 1996) performs Franz Liszt’s Mephisto Waltz No. 1. Lastly, Choi returns for a performance of Claude Debussy’s Images (Book I).

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 5, Op. 73
programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker, Daniel Barenboim and Claudio Abbado star at the Europakonzert 1994 in Meiningen, Germany, performing Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 5 and Johannes Brahms’ Symphony No. 2. The Berliner Philharmoniker, Daniel Barenboim and Claudio Abbado star at the Europakonzert 1994 in Meiningen, Germany, performing Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 5 and Johannes Brahms’ Symphony No. 2. Popularly known as the Emperor Concerto and composed in Vienna between 1809 and 1811, Piano Concerto No. 5 is Beethoven’s last completed piano concerto and often performed by star pianists such as Daniel Barenboim. A few decades later in 1877, Brahms completed his Second Symphony, which is often compared to Beethoven’s Sixth Symphony given its cheerful and pastoral character.

programme.title: Le Chant de L'éschiquier
programme.desc: A top-ranking female singer, four nimble-fingered born musicians, the monumental Buxheimer Codex and a stiff dose of idiosyncrasy; this is a recipe for a first-rate concert. programme.title: Mahler - Songs of a Wayfarer
programme.desc: Mexican conductor José Areán leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Gustav Mahler’s song cycle ‘Songs of a Wayfarer’ (Lieder eines fahrenden Gesellen). Baritone Jorge Lagunes is the soloist. This performance was recorded at Sala Nezahualcóyotl of the Centro Cultural Universitario in Mexico City, in 2012. Mexican conductor José Areán leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Gustav Mahler’s song cycle ‘Songs of a Wayfarer’ (Lieder eines fahrenden Gesellen). Baritone Jorge Lagunes is the soloist. Written in 1884-1885, the work consists of four songs, each based on one of the composer’s own poems, detailing a young man's unfortunate love and resulting journey through the world. Mahler uses the orchestra not just for accompaniment but to create a rich, immersive emotional landscape, with musical phrases that build and recede with great power and transparency. This performance was recorded at Sala Nezahualcóyotl of the Centro Cultural Universitario in Mexico City, in 2012.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concertos, BWV 1046-1051
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021. This performance was recorded at the Hall of Mirrors in the Köthen Castle, Germany. J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021. The concertos are based on the Italian concerto grosso form, in which a group of solo instruments is set against a large ensemble. Bach’s Brandenburg Concertos feature remarkable combinations of solo instruments and virtuoso solos. This performance was recorded at the Hall of Mirrors in the Köthen Castle, Germany.

programme.title: Berlioz - The Damnation of Faust
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle and the London Symphony Orchestra mark 150 years since the death of Hector Berlioz with his tempestuous oratorio, La damnation de Faust. Sir Simon Rattle and the London Symphony Orchestra mark 150 years since the death of Hector Berlioz with his tempestuous oratorio, La damnation de Faust. La damnation de Faust is a work born of the composer’s obsession with Goethe’s legendary tale. Once a righteous scholar, Faust allows himself to be corrupted by the devil, and drags the innocent around him into desperation and death. It’s a fable that defies definition - both a tragedy and dark comedy, with a central character both wise and despicable, and a play and epic poem in one.

Recorded in Muziekcentrum Enschede. The Valerius Ensemble, consisting of Eeva Koskinen (violin), René Geesing (cello) and Ingo Lulofs (piano) plays Rachmaninoff’s Trio élégiaque Nr. 1 and the Finale of Dvořák’s Piano Trio No.3, Op. 65. Rachmaninoff composed this Trio in 1892 at the age of 19. The work does not have an opus number and consists only of one movement, which is highly unusual for a Piano Trio. This concert was recorded at Muziekcentrum Enschede in the Netherlands on March 18, 2018.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor
programme.desc: Conductor Eduard Topchjan leads the Armenian National Philharmonic Orchestra in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor, Op. 37. Russian-born pianist Maya Oganyan (*2005) makes her solo debut with the orchestra. As an encore, Oganyan performs Der Bote (‘The Messenger’) by Ukrainian composer Valentin Silvestrov. This performance was recorded at the Aram Khachaturian Concert Hall in Yerevan, Armenia, in 2021. Conductor Eduard Topchjan leads the Armenian National Philharmonic Orchestra in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 3 in C minor, Op. 37. Russian-born pianist Maya Oganyan (*2005) makes her solo debut with the orchestra. Beethoven composed this concerto in 1800 and played the piano part himself at the piece’s premiere in 1803. Like two of his other major works -Symphony No. 5 and Piano Sonata No. 8 ‘Pathétique’ - this piano concerto is written in the key of C minor, which contributes to the work’s stormy character. As an encore, Oganyan performs Der Bote (‘The Messenger’) by Ukrainian composer Valentin Silvestrov. This performance was recorded at the Aram Khachaturian Concert Hall in Yerevan, Armenia, in 2021.

programme.title: Mozart - Requiem in D minor, K. 626
programme.desc: Daniel Harding leads the Orchestra and Choir of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino and four vocal soloists in a magnificent performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Requiem in D minor, K. 626. The soloists are soprano Christiane Karg, mezzosoprano Sara Mingardo, tenor Matthew Swensen, and bass Gianluca Buratto. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, in 2021. Daniel Harding leads the Orchestra and Choir of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino and four vocal soloists in a magnificent performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Requiem in D minor, K. 626. The soloists are soprano Christiane Karg, mezzosoprano Sara Mingardo, tenor Matthew Swensen, and bass Gianluca Buratto. The Austrian Count Walsegg commissioned Mozart to compose a Requiem in July 1791 to commemorate his late wife, Anna. At the time, Mozart was busy working on his operas La clemenza di Tito and The Magic Flute. By the time he started on the Requiem, in the fall of that same year, his health was seriously declining. Mozart passed away in December 1791, leaving the Requiem uncompleted. His pupil Franz Xaver Süssmayr completed Mozart’s swan song in the form known today, based on Mozart’s sketches and possibly verbal instructions. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, in 2021.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartet No. 12, Op. 127
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music. This program features Quatuor Ébène performing Beethoven’s String Quartet No. 5 in A major, Op. 18, No. 5; String Quartet No. 4 in C minor, Op. 18, No. 4; and String Quartet No. 12 in E-flat major, Op. 127. This concert was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris on December 17, 2020.

programme.title: Busoni - Kultaselle, 10 Variations
programme.desc: Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform a wonderful recital of works by Ferruccio Busoni, Franz Liszt, Frédéric Chopin, and Sergei Rachmaninoff. Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform a wonderful recital of works by Ferruccio Busoni, Franz Liszt, Frédéric Chopin, and Sergei Rachmaninoff. On the program are Busoni’s Kultaselle - 10 variations on a Finnish folksong; Liszt’s Two Elegies for cello and piano; Chopin’s Introduction and Polonaise brillante in C major, Op. 3; and Rachmaninoff’s Sonata in G minor for cello and piano, Op. 19. As an encore, the duo plays Leonard Bernstein’s iconic composition ‘Tonight’ from the musical West Side Story. This performance was recorded at Sala Verdi of the Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi in Milan, Italy, on November 4, 2024.

programme.title: Gluck - Iphigénie en Tauride
programme.desc: IIphigénie en Tauride (1779) is a four-act tragic opera by German-born composer Christoph Willibald Gluck. Diego Fasolis conducts the Orchestre National des Pays de la Loire and the Chœur d’Angers Nantes Opéra in this production. Among the soloists are Marie-Adeline Henry (Iphigénie), Charles Rice (Oreste), Sébastien Droy (Pylade), Jean-Luc Ballestra (Thoas), and Élodie Hache (Diane). This performance was recorded at the Grand Théâtre d’Angers, France, in 2020. Iphigénie en Tauride (1779) is a four-act tragic opera by German-born composer Christoph Willibald Gluck. Written for the French stage, the work’s premiere in 1779 at the Parisian Royal Academy of Music was a great success. Iphigénie en Tauride is one of the composer’s ‘reform operas’, meaning that the music was to follow the drama and its expression. Nicolas-François Guillard’s libretto is based on Claude Guimond de La Touche’s play of the same name, but ultimately it derives from Euripides’s famous ancient Greek drama. Set shortly after the Trojan War, Iphigénie, who was to be sacrificed by her father Agamemnon, is saved and carried off by the goddess Diana to Tauris, where Iphigénie becomes Diana’s high priestess. Diego Fasolis conducts the Orchestre National des Pays de la Loire and the Chœur d’Angers Nantes Opéra in this production. Among the soloists are Marie-Adeline Henry (Iphigénie), Charles Rice (Oreste), Sébastien Droy (Pylade), Jean-Luc Ballestra (Thoas), and Élodie Hache (Diane). This performance was recorded at the Grand Théâtre d’Angers, France, in 2020.

programme.title: A Mozart Celebration from Berlin
programme.desc: Performed in the grandeur of Berlin's foremost opera house, the Staatsoper Unter den Linden, the Mozart Celebration is dedicated to the life's work of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart. This one-time-only gala concert features exuberant Mozart pieces, performed by some of the world’s leading singers and musicians. Performed in the grandeur of Berlin's foremost opera house, the Staatsoper Unter den Linden, the Mozart Celebration is dedicated to the life's work of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart. This one-time-only gala concert features exuberant Mozart pieces, performed by some of the world’s leading singers and musicians. Conductor Julien Salemkour leads these beautiful performances played by the Staatskapelle Berlin. The star solists are Nicolaj Znaider (violin), Thomas Quasthoff (baritone) and Sylvia Schwartz (soprano). The program features Ouverture from la Clemenza di Tito, 'Violin Concerto No. 5', the song 'Chi sa, chi sa, qual sia', Piano Concerto No. 23, the aria 'Per questa bella mano', Papageno's Aria from the Magic Flute, the duet 'Papageno-Papagena' from The Magic Flute, and Symphony No. 40.

programme.title: Barbapapa
programme.desc: Crtana serija "Barbapapa" fokusira se na svakodnevne živote članova obitelji Barbapapa, bića koja mijenjaju oblik. Epizode uključuju avanture obitelji koja se upušta u neobične i često duhovite situacije, kao što je izgradnja rakete za Mars ili djeca koja pokušavaju od roditelja sakriti slona kojeg su pronašli u divljini, a iz svega toga likovi dobivaju novu, životnu pouku.

programme.title: Bibin čarobni svijet
programme.desc: 'Bibin čarobni svijet' je čudnovati animirani svijet za djecu predškolske dobi, koja kroz zabavne nastavke otkrivaju prirodu, uče kako se lijepo ponašati i stvaraju zdrave navike. U uzbudljivim pustolovinama, Bibi i njezino društvo, koje čine znatiželjni prijatelj Bobby i njihovi izvanzemaljski prijatelji Zazzy i Zina, istražuju začaranu šumu, rješavaju misterije i uče važne životne pouke.

programme.title: Maša i Medvjed
programme.desc: Animirani serijal prati pustolovine simpatične djevojčice Maše i Medvjeda, koji postanu prijatelji. Maša je hiperaktivna djevojčica dobrog srca, koja se izgubila u šumi, gdje je zalutala u Medvjedovu kuću, koji se od tada brine o njoj. Zajedno dožive brojne komične zgode, u koje Maša upadne zbog svoje razigranosti i znatiželje.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Zexal
programme.desc: Kada ambiciozni duelist Yuma upozna Astral, tajanstvenog posjetitelja iz drugog svemira, čini se kao sudbina. Yuma treba Astrala da ga nauči kako da se dvoboji, a Astral treba Yumu da mu pomogne povratiti sjećanja! Oni bi bili najveći tag tim dvoboja... osim što se ne slažu! Ovaj duel bolje da se brzo spoji jer ZEXAL je potpuno novi dvoboj s većim izazovima nego ikad prije! Fantastična nova čudovišta! Snažne nove karte! Tehnologija dvoboja s proširenom stvarnošću! Zajedno, dvoboj ide na sljedeću razinu! Ali ne brinite ako nikada prije niste bili u dvoboju: Dok Astral prolazi Yumom kroz osnove, novi gledatelji mogu pratiti i naučiti kako se natjecati. A za iskusne profesionalce, postoji mnogo nikad viđenih strategija koje se mogu koristiti u stvarnom životu! Yu-Gi-Oh! ZEXAL - Nova pravila, novi dvoboji!

programme.title: Novo jutro
programme.desc: Milionski auditorijum sa teritorije cele Srbije, svih starosnih i socijalnih kategorija svoj dan počinje uz "Novo jutro". Pored najpopularnijih voditeljskih tandema, gledaoci tokom cele radnje nedelje ostaju uz naše jutro zahvaljujući pravovremenom i aktuelnom izveštavanju kroz neizostavne rubrike: "Prelistavanje dnevne štampe", "Tema jutra", "(Ne)zapaženo" i mnoge druge. Zaštitni znak "Novog jutra" su i uključenja iz cele Srbije, ali i Beograda zahvaljujući autentičnom Filipu Maksimoviću i uvek nasmejanom Milanu Raoniću, uz koje ćemo i ovu sezonu početi u vrhu top liste gledanosti.

programme.title: Oteta, serija
programme.desc: Priča o Orhunu, koji želi da osveti svoju sestru, i Hiri, koja je zarobljenica svoje savesti... Orhun je uspešan biznismen koji je odrastao u bogatoj porodici bez ljubavi zajedno sa svojom sestrom bliznakinjom Nihan, mlađom sestrom Nursah i njihovom hladnom, udaljenom majkom Afife. Nihan je otišla da volonterski radi kao lekar u Eritreji, ali je odnedavno bilo nemoguće kontaktirati, a njena porodica je zabrinuta za nju. Dok traži svoju sestru, nailazi na Hiru, siromašnu devojku koja živi kao zatvorenik u rukama trgovaca ljudima. Kada saznaju da je Nihan otrovala i ubila lokalna banda, Orhun se slomi. Kada se ispostavi da je Hira zapravo bila ta koja je otrovala njegovu sestru, Orhun kuje zli plan osvete: povest će Hiru kući sa sobom i učiniti joj još gore. U međuvremenu, Afife, njihova majka, tajno je držala Orhunovog oca podalje od njegovog detinjstva. Orhun odlučuje da se oženi Hirom iz osvete. Afife mrzi ljude nižeg statusa i opsednuta je "čistom krvlju". Hoće li ovaj brak zatvoriti Afife, ili će par pronaći iskupljenje nakon što plati sve svoje obaveze?

programme.title: Klopka ljubavi, serija
programme.desc: Mračna kletva „visi nad bogatom porodicom Develioglu. Njen naslednik mora da je dečak, ali za Džihana, naslednik porodične imperije, deca su samo neostvarena želja. On u ljubav ne veruje. Sklopio je brak po dogovoru i smatra da je prosto nemoguće biti uspešan i u poslovanju i u ljubavi. Ljubav je za njega slabost. Njegova majka Mukader, nemilosrdni čuvar porodične tradicije i budućnosti, spremna je na sve da obezbedi svom sinu naslednika. Ona nudi Bejzi, Džihanovoj neplodnoj ženi, opasan dogovor: razvod za Džihanino potomstvo, uz obećanje da će se vratiti nakon rođenja njegovog sina. Inače Bejza je takođe iz imućne turske porodice.Sa druge strane, u siromašnoj četvrti Istanbula, živi mlada Hančer koja se bori sa životom u siromaštvu. Živi sa bolesnim bratom, njegovom ženom i bratancem. Hančer dobija ponudu koja će promeniti njenu sudbinu: brak sa Džihanom. Naravno uslov je da je plodna i poslušna, kao i da pristane na brak bez emocija. Iako njeno srce traži pravu ljubav, bolesni brat je tera na žrtvu.Džihan i Hančer nisu ni svesni da prave nepovratni korak. Život će im se ispuniti intrigama i tajnama, ništa više neće biti isto. Džihanova bivša žena Bejza neće nestati iz njihovih života. Oštra i moćna Mukader će uraditi sve da brak bude samo dogovor i da se posle rođenja naslednika reši Hančer. Hančer samo sanja da pomogne svojoj nesrećnoj porodici, dok Džihan traži ženu isključivo zbog naslednika.Hoće li ljubav ipak pronaći put u svetu gde svako teži želji za bolje?

programme.title: Odbačena, serija
programme.desc: Reč je o životnoj avanturi devojčice po imenu Melisa Celik, koja je kao beba ostala bez roditelja, a koja je ostala u sirotištu. Niko ne zna istinu o tome šta se desilo njenoj porodici. Melisa pokušava da ostane sa porodicom koja ju je usvojila, ali Besime, domaćica, ne želi Melisu i podvrgava je raznim mučenjima. Jednog dana, kada je kao žrtvu gneva stave na vrata, pred njom se pojavljuje muškarac, Metin. Tada počinju da pričaju, nesvesni da će im se život od tog trenutka potpuno promeniti.

programme.title: Sudbina, serija
programme.desc: Zejnep je oličenje gracioznosti i inteligencije, kojoj se svi dive. Ipak, ona ima skriveni ratnički duh. Halil, mlad bez roditelja i opterećen tugom, suočio se sa životnim nedaćama. Njihovi putevi se prepliću - Zejnep, slobodnog duha ispod svoje staložene spoljašnjosti, i Halil, odan porodici. Zajedno u vrtlogu ljubavi, oni nalaze da su njihove sudbine neraskidivo povezane. Dok se kreću putem prepunom izbora i posledica, ostaje pitanje: može li njihova ljubav izdržati izazove sa kojima se suočavaju?

programme.title: Ljubav i mržnja, serija
programme.desc: Serija prati zgode i nezgode bogate beogradske porodice Lazarević. Niko nije preboleo smrt majke, koja je bila stub porodice. Bogdanova nova supruga Kaća je moralno nepodobna. Temperamentna je i često stvara probleme unutar porodice. Takođe krije tajne iz prošlosti, koje je proganjaju. U biti je nesigurna ličnost i stidi se svojih seljačkih korena. Bogdanov sin Bojan je ženskaroš i ima aferu sa svojom maćehom Kaćom. To mu stvara niz neprilika, jer joj je obećao da će se razvesti od supruge i osnovati nov život sa njom. Međutim, Bojan ima niz ljubavnih veza. Njegova žena Ljubica je plemenita i odana osoba. Uspešna poslovna žena. Bojanov brat Miloš je novinar, nezadovoljan je, jer je zapravo želeo da bude pisac. Zbog toga često posegne za alkoholom. Njegova supruga Ivana očajnički želi da zatrudni, ali joj to ne uspeva. Njen otac Dušan je bivši narkoman i pravi joj dodatne probleme. Novinarka Zdenka je Miloševa koleginica iz lista "Jutarnja Zvezda", kojoj je porodica Lazarević omiljena tema. Bojanova i Miloševa sestra Olja je najmlađi član porodice i ona najviše pati zbog majčine smrti. Olja neočekivano zatrudni, otac deteta je njen profesor Vojin sa fakulteta. Nije sigurna šta da učini.

programme.title: Trenutak iz sna
programme.desc: "Trenutak iz sna" donosi nam snažne priče o ljudima koji su koračali trnovitom stazom života. Njih sudbina nije štedela, što se odrazilo na njihovo zdravstveno stanje i fizički izgled. Sada im se pruža jedinstvena prilika da putem učešća u emisiji "Trenutak iz sna" promene svoj život. Vrhunski stručnjaci u oblasti hirurgije, stomatologije i kozmetologije pomoći će u ostvarivanju njihovih želja, menjajući ne samo njihov izgled već i psihičko stanje i zdravlje.

programme.title: SCENA
programme.desc: Emisija se bavi aktuelnim dešavanjima iz života poznatih, prati bitne događaje na domaćoj javnoj sceni i donosi pregršt zanimljivih vijesti, intervjua i izveštaja o poznatima. Za ovu zabavnu emisiju o poznatima govorile su najveće domaće i regionalne zvijezde, a čine je i aktuealne vijesti iz svijeta šoubiznisa, kako domaćeg, tako i stranog. Ekipa emisije SCENA REGION donosi sve važne vijesti iz života poznatih i prati sve najznačajnije događaje, ne samo u zemlji, već i u regionu.

programme.title: Kuća od srca
programme.desc: Pomoći najvećem broju ugroženih porodica u kratkom roku - to je cilj ekipe serijala Kuća od srca. Razloga zbog koga je ova emisija najhumaniji TV serijal na ovim prostorima je mnogo - na prvom mestu, ekipa na čelu sa Žarkom Lazićem uspela je da zbrine više od 30 višečlanih porodica koje su živele na rubu egzistencije, bez krova nad glavom. Za Žarka ne postoji nemoguće: kroz dosadašnje sezone uspeo je da prevaziđe sve prepreke, čak i onda kada je to izgledalo nemoguće. Kako je TV Pink uvek imala sluha za potrebe najugroženijih, ova humana misija nastavlja se u osmoj sezoni serijala Kuća od srca.

programme.title: DNK
programme.desc: Potraga za neobičnim životnim pričama širom Srbije nastavlja se u emisiji DNK. Natalija Simović pokušaće da uz pomoć rezultata DNK analize unese mir u domove učesnika koji sumnjaju u očinstvo, a rasplet situacija često je turbulentan i dramatičan, a ponekad i komičan. Zbog toga je emisija „DNK već čitavu deceniju u samom vrhu gledanosti.

programme.title: Novo jutro
programme.desc: Milionski auditorijum sa teritorije cele Srbije, svih starosnih i socijalnih kategorija svoj dan počinje uz "Novo jutro". Pored najpopularnijih voditeljskih tandema, gledaoci tokom cele radnje nedelje ostaju uz naše jutro zahvaljujući pravovremenom i aktuelnom izveštavanju kroz neizostavne rubrike: "Prelistavanje dnevne štampe", "Tema jutra", "(Ne)zapaženo" i mnoge druge. Zaštitni znak "Novog jutra" su i uključenja iz cele Srbije, ali i Beograda zahvaljujući autentičnom Filipu Maksimoviću i uvek nasmejanom Milanu Raoniću, uz koje ćemo i ovu sezonu početi u vrhu top liste gledanosti.

programme.title: Mješoviti brak, serija
programme.desc: Serija "M(j)ešoviti brak" snimljena je na osnovu istoimene pozorišne predstave koja spada među najgledanije poslednjih godina. Naravno, dodati su novi likovi, proširena je priča, a gastarbajterska porodica Čađenovic vratila se u novu državu, Srbiju i Crnu Goru. Čuli su za promene, pa su odlučili da posle više godina boravka u Lucernu, u Švajcarskoj, teško zarađene devize ulože u biznis u Beogradu. Sasvim slučajno, prvi kadrovi ove serije snimljeni su u državi koja se zvala Jugoslavija, a prva epizoda završena je u državi, koja se poput ovog mešovitog braka Crnogorca i Srpkinje, zove Srbija i Crna Gora.

programme.title: Preživeti Beograd, serija
programme.desc: Preživeti Beograd je priča o mladim ljudima koji dolaze u Beograd da studiraju, njihovim željama, ljubavima, kao i ambicijama da uspeju u životu. Paralelno tu je i priča o njihovim roditeljima koji dolaze iz različitih socijalnih miljea. Zastupljeni su njihovi kontrasti, dolazak ljudi iz malih sredina u velikigrad. Preživeti Beograd je iskrena, dinamična serija koja se bavi optimizmom, ambicijama i emocijama, i samim tim mlađoj generaciji, ali i njihovim roditeljima nudi dobar sadržaj.

programme.title: Crveni mesec, serija
programme.desc: Ljubavna, ali i snažna istorijska priča, smeštena je u period od avgusta 1913, nakon pobede Srbije u Balkanskim ratovima kada je povratila deo teoritorije, do kraja 1915. godine, kada je austrougarska vojska okupirala Beograd. Glavni junak, mladi srpski oficir koga tumači Miloš Đurović, vraća se sa ratišta u rodnu kuću. Svadba mu je, tradicionalno, već zakazana, ali zaplet priče počinje kada se ćerka austrougarskog poslanika, koju igra Ivana Dudić, zainteresuje za njega. Nedopustivo za to vreme, koketna mlada dama, ne krije svoja osećanja prema mladom oficiru. Rasplet njihove ljubavne drame,koja je plod mašte autora, odvija se u realnom istorijskom periodu pred Veliki rat, pa se u scenariju pojavljuje još dvadesetak glavnih likova, uglavnom stvarnih istorijskih ličnosti. Ovo ostvarenje obiluje dramatičnim događajima, špijunskim intrigama, diplomatskim nadmudrivanjima, političkim spletkama i prevarama...

programme.title: Boj na Kosovu, film
programme.desc: Srpski knez Lazar 1389. godine odbija da se pokori turskom sultanu Muratu koji sa velikom vojskom nadire prema Srbiji da bi preko nje nastavio osvajanje Evrope. Iako svestan da je slabiji, bez dovoljno i dobro opremljene vojske, knez Lazar odlučuje da mu se suprotstavi. Srpski velikaši su nejedinstveni. Većina je za borbu makar i po cenu poraza ali se neki kolebaju. Sve što je za oružje sposobno upućuje se ka polju Kosovu. Bitka na Kosovu, 1389. godine završena je bez pobednika - obe su vojske iskrvarile i posustale. Ginu i Lazar i Murat. Ali ipak, boj na Kosovu je dobijen - ne za srpsku državu koja je uskoro pala u turske ruke - već za Evropu, koju je telima svojih junaka spasila od prvog i najjačeg naleta turske najezde.

programme.title: Lazar, film
programme.desc: Priča se odvija dvadesetak godina posle Drugog svetskog rata i govori o raspadu i ponovnom utemeljavanju jedne seoske porodice. Majka je poludela, a sin onemeo što je posledica nasilja kojem su bili izloženi tokom rata. U danu u kojem se drama događa, majka sinu, po ko zna koji put, kazuje njihovo stradanje kako bi pred njim opravdala sebe kao indirektnog krivca njegove nesreće. Tokom pričanja sin iz infantilnosti u kojoj je ostao, mada dvadesetogodišnjak, sazreva u čoveka, svesnog i odgovornog... * PROGRAM SE ROTIRA POSLE 12 SATI

programme.title: Idi mi, dođi mi, film
programme.desc: Mladi bračni par, Marija (Rialda Kadrić) i Boba (Vladimir Petrović) useljavaju u svoj novi stan i kreću u novi život. No uskoro počinju zapostavljati jedno drugo i dijete te život podređuju materijalnim stvarima. Život im ne olakšavaju niti djedovi Žika (Dragomir Bojanić Gidra) i Milan (Marko Todorović) koji se uporno miješaju u njihove privatne stvari. Srećom, Marija i Boba će vrlo brzo shvatiti da im je najveća vrijednost obitelj, kao i međusobna bliskost i ljubav. Popularni filmski serijal s područja bivše Jugoslavije, „Lude godine, započeo je svoje prikazivanje davne 1977., a slijedilo je još devet nastavaka do 1992. Sve od reda režirao ih je Zoran Čalić, a sedmi nastavak, snimljen 1985., dobio je naziv „Žikina dinastija. Iako u originalu zamišljena kao ozbiljna drama koja upozorava na društvene probleme poput seksa bez zaštite i tinejdžerske trudnoće, sporedni likovi Živorad "Žika" Pavlović (Dragomir Bojanić Gidra) te Milan Todorović (Marko Todorović) istaknuli su svoj talent za komediju te ubrzo preuzeli glavnu riječ. Iako ga filmska struka nije prihvatila, serijal je postao jedan od najpopularnijih u Jugoslaviji, pa čak i u zemljama Istočne Europe. Tako je glumica Rialda Kadrić primila pozivnicu Moskovskog filmskog festivala, koji je tada bio isključivo rezerviran za nove zvijezde Sovjetskog Saveza. Serija se pokazala odličnom odskočnom daskom mnogim budućim zvijezdama bivše Jugoslavije - Sonji Savić, Zoranu Cvijanoviću, Nikoli Koji, Gali Videnović i Branku Đuriću. Naziv serije osmišljen je kao parodija na popularnu američku seriju „Dinastija, koja je sredinom 80-ih osvojila gledatelje s područja tadašnje Jugoslavije.

programme.title: Tesna koža, film
programme.desc: U kući referenta Mite (Nikola Simić) vlada rasulo, a situacija na poslu nije ništa bolja. U pretrpanom i tijesnom stanu svatko traži kutak za sebe, a Mitina mala plaća je nedovoljna da zadovolji sve obiteljske potrebe i zahtjeve. Najmlađi sin ima problema u škola i sanja o rabljenoj Hondi, stariji sin je vječni apsolvent astronomije, a kći diplomirana pravnica koji bezuspješno traga za poslom. I na poslu je Miti sve gore, pa mu je zarada na listiću sportske prognoze posljednja slamka spasa koja bi mu omogućila da se izvuče iz vlastite kože koja mu postaje sve tjesnija.

programme.title: Uvek spremne žene, film
programme.desc: Sedam žena, sedam gubitnica. Nezaposlene, bez krova nad glavom, bez obitelji, bez uzvraćene ljubavi. U kontaktu i sudaru sa svijetom, uglavnom svijetom muškaraca, one gube, ali uvijek se ponovno vraćaju u borbu. Grupa se osipa. Neke bivaju pobjeđene životom, a neke same sobom. Preostale guraju dalje, same protiv svih.

programme.title: Obračun u kazino kabareu, film
programme.desc: Rile i Gile su prijatelji u detektivskoj agenciji, čiji je san da odu u Chicago. Budući da su tek započeli biznis i nemaju posla, odlučuju se prerušiti i opljačkati šefa Buzdu, kako bi ih on angažirao da pronađu lopove. Ipak za vrijeme ''operacije'' Rile i Gile bivaju opljačkani od strane misterioznog gospodina s bijelim šeširom. Kreću u potragu za njim i dospjevaju u kazino-kabare, čiji je vlasnik ozloglašeni Kornelone. Glavna atrakcija kabarea je prelijepa Silvija, ujedno i gazdina djevojka, čiji je menadžer gospodin s bijelim šeširom. Kornelone i gospodin s bijelim šeširom zaljubljeni su u Silviju i obojica predlažu Riletu i Giletu posao koji oni neće moći odbiti.

programme.title: Kakav deda takav unuk, film
programme.desc: Boba i Marija su zaposleni, imaju stan i sina i naizgled je sve uredu. Ali, dok su oni zauzeti svakodnevnim brigama, njihovog sina čuvaju djedovi i tu nastaju problemi. Njegov otac želi da unuka oblikuje po svojoj mjeri, a njen otac želi da mu obezbjedi klasično obrazovanje: muziku, jezike, itd. Zbog toga dolazi do niza sukoba i komičnih situacija. Četvrti nastavak urnebesnog serijala započetog filmom "Lude godine".

programme.title: Balkanski špijun, film
programme.desc: Beograđanin Ilija Čvorović (D. Stojković) bivši je staljinist koji je zbog svojih uvjerenja nedužan proveo nekoliko godina na Golom otoku. Pritisnuti lošom ekonomskom situacijom, Ilijina žena Danica (M. Banjac) iznajmi sobu podstanaru, povratniku iz Francuske, Petru Jakovljeviću (B. Todorović) koji u Beogradu namjerava otvoriti krojački salon. Ilija je pozvan na rutinski razgovor u policiju, kratko ispitivanje u vezi novog podstanara međutim taj kratki, rutinski sastanak u Iliji izazove sumnju te u podstanaru počne gledati agenta stranih sila, koji ima zadatak rušiti državu i njezin poredak. Načetih živaca, slabog srca, izgubljen u vremenu i prostoru Ilija postaje paranoičan, a svoje sumnje u podstanara uskoro počne dijeliti sa svojim bratom (Z. Lepetić) blizancem koji mu pristigne u pomoć. Danonoćno Ilija Čvorović prati podstanara fotoaparatom, dalekozorom i magnetofonom te u svoje sumnje uspije uvjeriti i suprugu Danicu no ne i kćer... Satira "Balkanski špijun" (1984) djelo je srpskog dramskog pisca Dušana Kovačevića, jednog od najpopularnijih suvremenih srpskih komediografa koji kroz satiru i komediju donosi sliku društvene stvarnosti te je često uspoređivan s najvećim srpskim komediografom, Nušićem. "Balkanski špijun" priča o čovjeku punom straha, čija uvjerenja i revnost više ne trebaju nikome te tako svi njegovi postupci postaju groteskni i smiješni. Iliju Čvorovića utjelovio je uvijek izvrsni Danilo Bata Stojković koji već samom svojom pojavom i jasnom mimikom izaziva smijeh. Dramske se situacije uglavnom odvijaju na verbalnom nivou, glavni glumac izgovara tirade paranoidnih uvjerenja koje su prekidane naivnim pitanjima njegove supruge (Mira Banjac).

programme.title: Groznica ljubavi, film
programme.desc: Mladić i djevojka se strašno vole, ali kad ona zatrudni situacija postaje dramatična. Djevojka iz zdravstvenih razloga ne smije abortirati, a njena majka ima veoma ambiciozne planove. Majka je skriva do poroda, a preko ovjetnika stupa u kontakt s njemačkim bračnim parom koji želi "kupiti" bebu. Djevojka, razočarana, pristaje na ovo rješenje. Nakon što mladić pronađe djevojku i sazna da je postao otac, odlučuje oteti i sakriti dijete.

programme.title: Specijalno vaspitanje, film
programme.desc: Socijalno-psihološka drama. Pera Antić Trta (S. Štimac) izvrgnut je velikoj sramoti: nezakonito je dijete, ne zna se tko mu je otac, a majka pijanica je u zatvoru. Pera je od malena prepušten ulici, a nakon nekoliko sitnih krađa lokalni sud mu odredi nekoliko godina u beogradskom popravilištu. U Beograd ga odvede milicajac Cane (Lj. Samardžić), jedan od rijetkih koji se zauzima za njega i koji je svjestan njegovih patnji. U domu će se sprijateljiti sa šutljivim osobenjakom Ljupčetom (A. Berček) kojega već "posebno motri" odgojitelj Munižaba (B. Fehmiu). On, naime, u njemu i u novopridošlom Peri vidi nešto ljudsko i odluči im dati više slobode nego ostalim štićenicima, vjerujući da će ih tako popraviti... Uspio prvijenac jugoslavenskoga redatelja Gorana Markovića (Nacionalna klasa, Tajvanska kanasta, Kordon). Redatelj, koji se u cijelom svom opusu najviše zanimao za položaj čovjeka u suvremenom društvu i urbanoj sredini, u svom prvijencu kroz iznimno dobro razrađene likove razmatra problem maloljetničke delinkvencije i odrastanja u popravnom domu. Uz izvrsnog Ljubišu Samardžića, sjajnu je ulogu ostvario mladi Slavko Štimac, našoj publici najpoznatiji iz filma "Vlak u snijegu". Film je vrlo dobro primila tadašnja jugoslavenska publika, a osvojio je i nagradu za najbolji debitantski film na festivalu u Mannheimu 1977.

Casper the Funky Ghost: Bootsy Collins à Vienne, Jazz
programme.desc: Bootsy Collins, famed for playing with George Clinton and his very own Rubber Band, is used to playing syncopated, hard and relentlessly rhythmic music. With this unique style Bootsy was a major influence on the development of funk. Now in his 60s, the bassist seems animated by a new energy that reflects his new work on the album ‘Tha Funk Capitol of the World’. With this album, Bootsy Collins pays tribute to the artists with whom he worked during his frantic career: from James Brown and Parliament-Funkadelic to Fatboy Slim. During this concert, recorded at the festival Jazz à Vienne, Bootsy maintains that same energy, giving a spectacular show.

programme.title: Kim Hoorweg at BIRD, Rotterdam, Soul
programme.desc: After Dutch singer Kim Hoorweg landed her first record contract from Universal Music at the age of 14, her musical career took off and she became a well-known name in the Netherlands jazz community. Famous artists such as Candy Dulfer, Raul Midón, Metropole Orkest, and Gino Vannelli, to name a few, have already performed with the singer on numerous occasions. This time, Kim Hoorweg performs at BIRD in Rotterdam, the Netherlands, together with fellow Dutch musicians Anton Goudsmit on guitar, Niels Broos on keyboards, and Yoran Vroom on drums.

programme.title: Jimmy Witherspoon Quartet & Rozaa Wortham 1985, Blues
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Jimmy Witherspoon and Rozaa Wortham, two incredible brilliant jazz musicians. Rozaa Wortham starts off the show with the Jimmy Witherspoon Quartet. Swinging and full of energy she performs ‘It Don’t Mean A Thing’. Jimmy Witherspoon, known for the song Ain’t Nobody’s Business ends the show with some astounding lean-back blues.

programme.title: Kurhaus Scheveningen: Beets & Rosenwinkel, Fusion
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, Toots Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who has a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey. Although Beets’ parents originally did not associate the word musician with the word career, music is definitely in the family’s blood. At this concert at the Kurhaus in Scheveningen, the Netherlands, Peter Beets teams up with the world-famous guitarist Kurt Rosenwinkel. With a career spanning almost twenty-five years and including collaborating with dynamic peers like Brad Mehldau, Brian Blade, Mark Turner, Joshua Redman, Chris Potter, as well as esteemed jazz legends like Joe Henderson, Paul Motian and Gary Burton, Rosenwinkel’s indelible mark in music is the consummation of being steeped in the rich and deep traditions of jazz, springing off of the shoulders of such vital underpinnings to elevate his own art to new heights, evolving the language in a way no other guitarist has since his arrival. This collaboration between Beets and Rosenwinkel guarantees brilliant music.

programme.title: Thelonious Monk - Jazz Greats, Jazz
programme.desc: The idiosyncratic pianist and composer Thelonious Monk (1917-1982) is one of the all-time greats of jazz. His music went largely misunderstood for the first 15 years of his career, after which he was rightly hailed as a genius, and received credit as a founding father of bebop. Several concerts from his 1966 European tour were recorded for television, featuring his quartet of Charles Rouse (tenor saxophone), Lawrence Gales (bass) and Benjamin Riley (drums). His quartet performed Epistrophy, 'Round Midnight, and Lulu's Back in Town in Warsaw for Polish television on April 4, 1966. On April 17, the same quartet performed a short set in Copenhagen for Danish television, featuring Lulu's Back in Town, Don't Blame Me, and Epistrophy.

programme.title: Starlight, Concert
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music - not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1987, American pianist Armando Anthony "Chick" Corea was one of the artists appearing here. Together with Frank Gambale on guitar, Eric Marienthal on saxophone, John Patitucci on bass and Dave Weckl on drums, Corea performed jazz fusion with his Elektric Band - a jazz subgenre inspired by the rock music and electronic instruments of the day. The band was nominated for two Grammy Awards.

programme.title: Move Over, Concert
programme.desc: In 1988, Dee Dee Bridgewater was one of the first great jazz singers to perform at the Jazz Festival in Ramatuelle. In 2016, the story seems to repeat itself as her daughter China Moses took the stage at Ramatuelle. Over the years, China Moses has become a mature performer with a unique style: rocky voice, sharp sense of swing, and intense/energetic stage presence. After signing compilations dedicated to Dinah Washington and blues, Moses released in 2016 an album of his own compositions, entitled "Whatever". Get ready for a most entertaining performance combining jazz, soul, and hip-hop.

programme.title: Kenny G - North Sea Jazz, Smooth
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1987, smooth jazz saxophonist and crowd-favorite Kenny G serenaded those attending the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. After beginning his career in the Love Unlimited Orchestra, he now brings his own band for this hypnotic performance.

programme.title: Georgie Fame & the Blue Flames, Modern
programme.desc: Georgie Fame, known for "Yeh, Yeh" and "The Ballad of Bonnie and Clyde" makes a triumphant comeback with The Blue Flames. Georgie Fame and the Blue Flames was a popular band in the UK in the '60s, celebrated for its R&B, soul, jazz, ska, and pop sounds. The training was largely inspired by ska, a popular musical style in Jamaican cafes in London at the time. It was the song "Green Onions" from the Booker T & The MG that inspired Georgie to incorporate the Hammond organ into her compositions. This performance by Georgie Fame and the Blue Flames is brimming with blues and soulful sounds that will delight the group's old and new fans.

programme.title: Les McCann: Live in New Orleans, Smooth
programme.desc: Self-taught musician Les McCann became the international jazz superstar he is today after the release of his album Swiss Movement which he recorded in 1968 with the late Eddie Harris. Yet there is much more to this musician than that one record. McCann moves comfortably from one jazz style to the next, demonstrating impressive chops in all areas, from bop to fusion, and from vocals to the keys of the electric piano, clavinet, or synthesizer. His mix of church and swing music captures the spirit of the time perfectly, even when an illness prevented him from playing with more than one finger at a time in the early 1990s. In today’s broadcast, McCann takes gospel back to New Orleans, where he played this set in 1983. McCann’s vocals shine in the soulful performances of several of his hits, including Just Like Magic, backed by his wonderful Magic Band of saxophonist Bobby Bryant Jr., bassist Curtis Robertson Jr., and drummer Tony St. James.

programme.title: Blue Note 75th Anniversary: Blue Note All Stars, Modern
programme.desc: Blue Note Records is arguably the most prestigious jazz label. Since its foundation in 1939, it has continued to attract young talent. To celebrate the label's 75th anniversary in 2014, young musicians formed the 2014 Blue Note All Stars and appeared at the Blue Note Jazz Festival at the Gaîté Lyrique in Paris. Pianist Robert Glasper, guitarist Lionel Loueke, virtuoso trumpeter Ambrose Akinmusire, bassist Derrick Hodge, saxophonist Marcus Strickland and drummer Kendrick Scott constituted the dream line-up. United for the concert, they played songs from their respective albums, as well as great standards revisited for the occasion and to bring you the next level of jazz!

programme.title: Down, Concert
programme.desc: Two top-tier Belgian musicians - guitarist Philip Catherine and bassist Jean-Louis Rassinfosse - accompany American jazz trumpeter and vocalist Chet Baker during this 1985 performance at the beautiful Brussels Jazz Club, located on the Grand-Place, the Belgian capital’s central square. The trio plays Charlie Mariano’s Crystal Bells, the title track of their acclaimed 1983 album. Other songs played during this legendary concert include Down and How Deep is the Ocean.

programme.title: Martina - Da Pá Virada Sessions, Jazz
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the artists taking part in this series is Martina Marana. Vocalist, instrumentalist, and composer Martina Marana uses the power of irony to show how women instrumentalists are misjudged. In her music, Martina breaks free of sexist labels, reclaiming her own power as musician and composer. A gifted lyricist, Marana makes uncompromising, unique music.

programme.title: Seine Sessions: World Music, World
programme.desc: The term "jam-session" was born in the 1920s, when black and white musicians gathered in smoke-filled bars after their respective concerts to enjoy the kind of jazz they could not play in traditional sets. Bing Crosby was a regular at these sessions, and had fun marking the first and third beats of musical phrases by clapping hands, which the musicians call "jammin' the beat". Today, the Seine Sessions revive the happy years of "jam sessions", while the cream of jazz, blues, gipsy and funk Parisian scenes occurs on the boards of the legendary restaurant and jazz club Le Réservoir. Entitled "World Music", this episode hosted by Eddy King features unique performances by artists playing together for the first time, and interviews with Teófilo Chantre, Tiwitine, Kinsy Ray, and many others.

programme.title: Michelle David - Jazz in Duketown, Jazz
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned artists. The talented American singer Michelle David performs pop and gospel music that feeds the heart and soothes the soul. Having grown up with the church, she started singing at the age of four. A year later she joined her first band, The Mission of Love. In 1980 she enrolled at Fiorello H. LaGuardia High School of Music & Art and Performing Arts in New York City, known from the film 'Fame'. During this time, she appeared as an extra in the legendary comedy film 'Ghostbusters'. Musicals and tours with the bands of Diana Ross and Michael Bolton followed.

programme.title: Under the Surface - Live at Bimhuis 2018, Free
programme.desc: Under the Surface is an improvisational jazz band formed by drummer Joost Lijbaart, vocalist Sanne Rambags, and guitarist Bram Stadhouders. Sanne Rambags, the youngest artist of the trio, is one of the few vocalists of her generation who able to improvise effortlessly, be it by using her voice as an instrument blending with the sounds of the band, or by performing her own poetry. Joost Lijbaart, known from bands by Yuri Honing, is one of the top artists of the Dutch jazz scene. Guitarist Bram Stadhouders is one of the most renowned musicians of improvisational music in Europe. Together, the three Dutch musicians have developed their own universal language within the genre. Their performance at Bimhuis showcases their unique intergenerational chemistry and hypnotizing sound. Bimhuis Amsterdam provides a platform for pioneering national and international musicians by hosting over 300 concerts a year.

programme.title: Belgium Sessions: Trio Florizoone - Massot, Latin
programme.desc: In this DJAZZ Belgium Sessions performance, which was recorded at AED Studios in Lint, Belgium, we witness Europe’s finest jazz musicians at work. A wide variety of international jazz musicians give a creative, up-close and inside insight into their art of playing jazz music. Young talent and established jazz musicians play to their heart’s content: take for instance this unusual performance by the trio Massot/Florizoone/Horbaczewski. This adventurous threesome pushes the boundaries of jazz, folk and classical music. There is a certain commonality between the instruments they play: accordion, tuba and cello share a richness of sound, as well as a broad register and a photogenic appearance. When improvising, the trio produces the weirdest and wackiest, but also most moving sounds.

programme.title: Honeywood, Concert
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned artists. One of them is Dutch singer, pianist, composer and bandleader Ruben Hein. Widely praised for his warm and characteristic voice and his offbeat piano playing, Ruben Hein is the artistic director and conductor of the National Youth Jazz Orchestra (NJJO). At Jazz in Duketown he performs a jazzy set, accompanied by his 18 finest proteges.

programme.title: VEIN Plays Ravel, Fusion
programme.desc: A sound support with provocative combinations, a modern music laboratory, a vehicle of inspiration whose importance has been proven by many high-profile collaborations. Music lovers who appreciate jazz for its ability to provoke and continuously question the status quo certainly do not expect that such a standard set in its configuration finds itself completely detached from tradition. But sometimes, the more the DNA of a set is anchored in tradition, the higher the margin to give way to novelty. Innovation is at the heart of the approach of VEIN, a bold Swiss ensemble composed of brothers Michael and Florian Arbenz, and bassist Thomas Lähns, for whom the term "piano trio" has long been too restrictive.

programme.title: Raj za dame, serija
programme.desc: Talijanska televizijska serija nastala prema romanu Emilea Zole 'Au Bonheur des dames' iz 1883., no radnja je premještena u Milano, 1956. godine. Glavni lik je Teresa, mlada žena koja ostavi Salva, zaručnika kojeg joj je otac odabrao jer je gradonačelnikov sin, i sa Sicilije odlazi u Milano. Teresa se nada da će se ondje zaposliti u stričevoj trgovini. No kad stigne u Milano, dozna da joj je stric na rubu bankrota i da je optužen za palež kombija ugledne robne kuće Raj za dame zbog koje gubi posao. Vlasnik robne kuće je Pietro Mori, mladi poduzetnik upitne prošlosti, koji je nakon putovanja u SAD u poslijeratno doba uspio otvoriti elegantnu i modernu robnu kuću. Teresa se prijavi na natječaj za prodavačicu u robnoj kući. Nakon niza peripetija uspije se zaposliti i pokaže da je ambiciozna i poduzetna djevojka i ubrzo stekne povjerenje kolega. Djevojka se na kraju ludo zaljubi u Pietra Morija, no mora se vratiti na Siciliju jer je njezin otac obećao gradonačelniku Castelbuona da će se Teresa udati za njegovog sina Salva.

Tito između Istoka i Zapada: Između dva bloka
programme.desc: Ova epizoda daje odgovore na pitanja kako se dogodila druga kriza u jugoslovensko-sovjetskim odnosima i zašto je Jugoslavija u tom periodu pokrenula prekid Programa američke vojne pomoći i time napravila otklon i od Zapada. Pošto se, krajem 1957. i početkom 1958. godine, Jugoslavija našla u veoma teškoj poziciji, rešenje je pronašla u okretanju ka vanblokovskim državama i takozvanom trećem svetu.

programme.title: Vavilon
programme.desc: Tokom aprila u Beogradu je bilo prisutno više književnika i autora koji borave u inostranstvu i Vavilon je iskoristio priliku da sa njima razgovara i predstavi njihove knjige. Neposredan povod za razgovor sa profesorom na departmanu slavistike Univerziteta Mišel de Montenj u Bordou, Francuska, Milivojem Srebrom, su nedavno objavljene dve knjige - Studija "Ivo Andrić u francuskom ključu" za koju je ovenčan nagradom "Đorđe Jovanović", koja se dodeljuje za najbolje delo iz oblasti književne kritike i esejistike. Druga knjiga Milivoja Srebra, "Književnost krize", objavljena je takođe protekle godine, kao izbor o kritičkim tekstovima o srpskoj književnosti, delima koja su izlazila tokom 80-tih godina prošlog veka.

programme.title: Savremeni svetski pisci: Andrej Makin
programme.desc: Romaneskna životna putanja francusko-ruskog pisca Andreja Makina dala je posebnu notu njegovoj poetici. Rođen 1957. u Krasnojarsku u Sibiru, odrasta u sovjetskom režimu, u Moskvi završava Filološki fakultet, a sa 30 godina napušta Rusiju i dolazi u Pariz, gde traži politički azil. Sledi vreme lutanja, nemaštine i bezuspešnog obijanja pragova izdavača. Kada 1995. dobija Gonkurovu nagradu za roman Francusko zaveštanje, Andrej Makin preko noći postaje zvezda francuske književne scene.

Dobar dan BIH
programme.desc: Cilj emisije "Dobar dan BiH", koju radnim danima gledate na Hayat TV, prije svega jeste potaknuti pozitivne promjene u društvu, kod pojedinaca, ali i sistemske promjene. Ukazujemo na probleme, ne samo kako bismo informisali o njima, nego kako bismo podstakli razmišljanje i u konačnici ponudili rješenja. Radimo to dajući prostor ljudima koji su stručni za uske oblasti i koji su pozvani da savjetuju, kako vlast, tako i građane. Uvijek ističemo pozitivne priče i tragamo za njima kako bismo bili podrška onima koji su uspješni, ali i motiv drugima da pokušaju uspjeti. U našoj emisiji, pored poznatih lica iz svijeta politike, ekonomije, sporta, kulture, iz naše zemlje i svijeta, prostor nerijetko imaju medijski nepromovisane osobe, koje svojim "ljudskim" pričama i iskustvima obogaćuju sadržaj i daju vlastiti osvrt na ono što je njihov uspjeh ili problem.

programme.title: Planina ljubavi, serija
programme.desc: 113. epizoda - Halime moli Tanera da ne odlazi iz Gedelija i ne osuđuje ju na čežnju s kojom je živjela uz njegovog oca. Rođaci uviđaju da su problemi stanovnika Gedelija postali preveliki zbog dugotrajne suše, pa razmišljaju o tome da pokušaju pronaći rješenje iako su odustali od bavljenja izumima. Rođaci shvataju da na imanju jednog od stanovnika Gedelija postoji podzemna voda koja bi se mogla koristiti za cijeli gradić. Džemile razgovara s ocem o uspomenama koje u njima bude teške emocije. Ramazan traži Erkanovu pomoć u namjeri da zaprosi Asuman, ali njegov romantični plan ipak polazi naopako

programme.title: Zarobljena, serija
programme.desc: 678. epizoda - Aziz ima novi plan kako da dođe do velikog šefa. Gurbuz strahuje da im plan neće uspjeti. Ejlul smišlja način kako da otkloni Afifine sumnje i privuče Orhunovu pažnju. Behije je pronalazi bez svijesti u kupatilu, a pored nje je bočica s tabletama. Gurbuz razgovara s Edže telefonom i nagovara je da produži odmor. Aziz pokušava utješiti uplašenu Elif i govori joj da će njegov zadatak uskoro biti završen. Elif se trudi pružiti mu podršku.

programme.title: Igmanska džamija, svjedočanstvo vjere, borbe i ponosa
programme.desc: 30 je godina od otvaranja Igmanske džamije. One koja je simbol vjere, snage, želje, zajedništva, ali i istrajnosti na putu istine, u jednom teškom, bolnom vremenu za našu domovinu. U vremenu kad su pripadnici Armije RBiH, u toku agresije, branili svoju zemlju, svoj narod, svoju čast i dostojanstvo, podigli su i ovu igmansku ljepoticu. Ona je bila njihova potreba, njih mir, njihova oaza u koju su dolazili, bez obzira na sve nedaće sa kojima su se suočavali. Njihova je žrtva bila je velika, a namjera čista i iskrena. A naše je danas da se toga sjećamo i džamiju čuvamo. U dokumentarnom filmu "Igmanska džamija, svjedočanstvo vjere, borbe i ponosa", donosimo najznačajnije, ali i najzanimljivije momente koji su vezani za izgradnju igmanske džamije i ljude koji su tada bili na Igmanu.

programme.title: Dan džamija
programme.desc: Centralna manifestacija u povodu Dana džamija, održat će se u džamiji Arnaudija u Banjoj Luci.Dan džamija obilježava se u znak sjećanja na dan kada je u Banjoj Luci 1993. godine minirana džamija Ferhadija, jedna od najznačajnijih džamija u našoj zemlji, ali i ostalih 613 džamija, 218 mesdžida, 69 mekteba, četiri tekije, 37 turbeta i 405 drugih objekata u vlasništvu Islamske zajednice.

programme.title: Vjetrovi ljubavi, serija
programme.desc: 105. epizoda - Gulhan požuruje Halila da iz vile izbaci Aslanlije, ali Halil se snebiva. Nakon toga Gulhan ružno sanja Halila. Songul to koristi za dodatni napad na Zejnep. Jusuf podsjeća Guldže da ipak nije sama na svijetu, da ima njega. Hakan donosi poklon Ferihi. Halil ide po savjet kod majstora Aziza. Guldže pronalazi smrtovnicu svoje sestre u Jusufovoj jakni i shvata da joj je Jusuf skrivao istinu. Halil saopćava Zejnep svoju odluku da ona i njena porodica moraju otići s imanja za mjesec.

programme.title: Mehmed: Osvajač svijeta, serija
programme.desc: 195. epizoda - Sultan se dvoumi kome da pomogne, svom velikom veziru ili čovjeku kojeg zove bratom. Vlad biva teško ranjen. Kurtču se raduje jer mu je brat živ. Zahvaljući Sarudžinim topovima dolazi do preokreta u bici. Lutfi liječi ranjenog Vlada. Počinje napad na tvrđavu Jastura. Sultan bira izaslanika koji će otići caru Komnenu.

programme.title: Okovana ljubav, serija
programme.desc: 9. epizoda - Dženap od Isaka Alija zahtijeva da mu preda Ješil, optužujući je za smrt jednog sina i nesreću drugog, ali Isak Ali to odbija učiniti i proglašava ga neprijateljem. Dok se sukob produbljuje, Dženap planira silom uzeti Ješil i uništiti porodicu Bičakči. Isak Ali odlučuje da Ješil ostane uz svoju djecu, ali ne u vili nego u gostinjskoj kući, što izaziva nove napetosti u porodici. Nakon što Jasin doživi nesreću i završi u bolnici, Isak Ali sve više nervoze pokazuje prema sinu. Dženap potajno naređuje da se prikupi sve o Bičakčijevima, spremajući osvetu koja će tek eskalirati.

programme.desc: Cilj emisije "Dobar dan BiH", koju radnim danima gledate na Hayat TV, prije svega jeste potaknuti pozitivne promjene u društvu, kod pojedinaca, ali i sistemske promjene. Ukazujemo na probleme, ne samo kako bismo informisali o njima, nego kako bismo podstakli razmišljanje i u konačnici ponudili rješenja. Radimo to dajući prostor ljudima koji su stručni za uske oblasti i koji su pozvani da savjetuju, kako vlast, tako i građane. Uvijek ističemo pozitivne priče i tragamo za njima kako bismo bili podrška onima koji su uspješni, ali i motiv drugima da pokušaju uspjeti. programme.desc: 679. epizoda - Hira je zabrinuta za Ejlul jer se ne oporavlja nakon pokušaja samoubistva. programme.title: Lijepe bosanske džamije
programme.desc: Danas, na Dan džamija govorimo o tragovima jednog naroda u vremenu, o ljudima koji ih čuvaju, o ljepoti koja nije slučajna i o vrijednostima koje se ne smiju zaboraviti. Lijepe su bosanske džamije. Sve do jedne nose priču, nose dušu svakog ko ih je zijaretio makar jednom. U njima srce ljepše, mirnije kuca. Tu, u zidovima, su i dalje utkane linije lijepe islamske kaligrafije. U geometriji ornamenata krije se sklad koji podsjeća da red postoji i kada ga u životu ne vidimo. Ljepota i tišina mihraba i taj pogled prema kibli i dalje postoji, smjer, pripadnost i smisao.

programme.title: Mehmed: Osvajač svijeta, serija
programme.desc: 196. epizoda - Mehmedova vojska dolazi do Ponta, a jedan dio snaga pod Ishak-pašom dolazi u pomoć prinčevima Bajazitu i Mustafi, koje napada Sulejman. Eren želi postati akandžija. Ali-beg kao Mehmedov izaslanik odlazi kod cara Ponta, Komnena. Od cara traži da se preda i da prijeđe na islam. Vlad dolazi u verbalni sukob s Mahmud-pašom, koji ga podsjeća da je on ubio Mehmedovog brata Aladina. Mehmed odlučuje pozvati Vlada na vijeće, kako bi se upoznao s planom napada na Pont i pao u iskušenje da iznevjeri sultana i sve otkrije caru Komnenu.

programme.title: Vjetrovi ljubavi, serija
programme.desc: 106. epizoda - Zejnep se bori sa spoznajom da ona i njena porodica moraju napustiti imanje. To i Halilu teško pada, mada to krije, i traži od Erena da u blizini pronađe lijepu kuću za porodicu Aslanli. Songul vijest o odlasku Aslanlija saznaje od Gulhan i presretna je. Za to vrijeme, Zumrut je preokupirana idejom o uređenje njene sobe. Guldže se osjeća izdanom od Jusufa jer joj nije rekao za smrt njene sestre. Gulhan i Tekin odlaze na kraći odmor. Feriha dolazi u posjetu Hakanu, koji je time oduševljen.

programme.title: Okovana ljubav, serija
programme.desc: 9. epizoda - Dženap od Isaka Alija zahtijeva da mu preda Ješil, optužujući je za smrt jednog sina i nesreću drugog, ali Isak Ali to odbija učiniti i proglašava ga neprijateljem. Dok se sukob produbljuje, Dženap planira silom uzeti Ješil i uništiti porodicu Bičakči. Isak Ali odlučuje da Ješil ostane uz svoju djecu, ali ne u vili nego u gostinjskoj kući, što izaziva nove napetosti u porodici. Nakon što Jasin doživi nesreću i završi u bolnici, Isak Ali sve više nervoze pokazuje prema sinu. Dženap potajno naređuje da se prikupi sve o Bičakčijevima, spremajući osvetu koja će tek eskalirati.

programme.title: Miraculous: Pustolovine Bubamare i Crnog Mačka
programme.desc: Samo oni mogu spasiti Pariz od zlikovaca! Marinette Dupain-Cheng i Adrien Agreste naizgled su obični pariški srednjoškolci koji se ni po čemu ne razlikuju od svojih vršnjaka, no oboje kriju misterioznu tajnu - upravo su oni odabrani da svoj grad spase od zlikovaca. Zahvaljujući magičnom dragulju poznatom pod nazivom Miraculous, Marinette i Adrien transformiraju se u superjunake Bubamaru i Crnog Mačka te zajedno surađuju kako bi Pariz zaštitili od beskrupuloznog Hawka Motha koji na različite načine pokušava ukrasti Miraculous i oduzeti im moći, prijeteći kako će ih iskoristiti protiv njih te obične građane pretvoriti u negativce. No iako rade zajedno, ni Bubamara ni Crni Mačak ne znaju međusobne identitete. Mariette je potajno zaljubljena u Adriena, a on smatra kako je ona samo još jedna djevojka iz njegovog razreda. Miracolous: Pustolovine Bubamara i Crnog Mačka animirana je akcijska serija autora Jeremyja Zaga, nastala 2015. godine u produkciji francuskih studija Zagtoona i Method Animationa u suradnji s produkcijskim kućama De Agostini Editore u Italiji, Toei Animation u Japanu te SAMG Animation u Južnoj Koreji. Ideja o Bubamari i Crnom mačku nastala je na temelju američkih i francuskih stripova te japanske animacije, poput priče o Spider-Manu ili Mjesečevoj ratnici. Prva sezona krenula je s emitiranjem krajem 2015. godine, a ukupno je snimljeno 48 epizoda. O velikoj popularnosti serije svjedoči potvrđena treća sezona koja bi trebala biti premijerno prikazana 2019. godine te osvojena Teen Choice Awards nagrada za najbolju animiranu TV seriju iz 2018. godine.

Zahvaljujući magičnom dragulju poznatom pod nazivom Miraculous, Marinette i Adrien transformiraju se u superjunake Bubamaru i Crnog Mačka te zajedno surađuju kako bi Pariz zaštitili od beskrupuloznog Hawka Motha koji na različite načine pokušava ukrasti Miraculous i oduzeti im moći, prijeteći kako će ih iskoristiti protiv njih te obične građane pretvoriti u negativce. No iako rade zajedno, ni Bubamara ni Crni Mačak ne znaju međusobne identitete. Mariette je potajno zaljubljena u Adriena, a on smatra kako je ona samo još jedna djevojka iz njegovog razreda. Miracolous: Pustolovine Bubamara i Crnog Mačka animirana je akcijska serija autora Jeremyja Zaga, nastala 2015. godine u produkciji francuskih studija Zagtoona i Method Animationa u suradnji s produkcijskim kućama De Agostini Editore u Italiji, Toei Animation u Japanu te SAMG Animation u Južnoj Koreji. Ideja o Bubamari i Crnom mačku nastala je na temelju američkih i francuskih stripova te japanske animacije, poput priče o Spider-Manu ili Mjesečevoj ratnici. Prva sezona krenula je s emitiranjem krajem 2015. godine, a ukupno je snimljeno 48 epizoda. O velikoj popularnosti serije svjedoči potvrđena treća sezona koja bi trebala biti premijerno prikazana 2019. godine te osvojena Teen Choice Awards nagrada za najbolju animiranu TV seriju iz 2018. godine.

programme.title: PJ Masks
programme.desc: Danju su sedmogodišnji Connor, Amaya i Greg obični školarci kao i sva druga djeca njihove dobi. No, kad se u gradu dogodi kakva nevolja, ovi posebno znatiželjni i pravdoljubivi mališani spremni su za svoju misiju. Kako bi ostali neopaženi, moraju čekati noć i da grad utone u san. U to vrijeme, umjesto da se kao i njihovi vršnjaci pripremaju za spavanje, naši junaci navlače svoje pidžame i čarobno se transformiraju u superjunake, PJ Masks. Oni postaju Catboy, superbrz i okretan dječak, Gekko, nevjerojatno snažan dječak koji može pomicati zidove te Owlette, djevojčica koja može letjeti i vidjeti na velike udaljenosti. Zajedno, ovo troje superdjece mogu svladati bilo koji problem - PJ Masks plove u noć kako bi spasili dan! Animirana serija "PJ Masks" nastala je prema maštovitom, originalnom i zapanjujućem serijalu bestseler knjiga Les Pyjamasques, francuskog autora Romualda Racioppoa. U njegovoj rodnoj Francuskoj, u kojoj je prva knjiga iz serijala objavljena 2008., do danas je objavljeno impresivnih 15 naslova, s planom izdavanja čak dva nova naslova svake godine pa s pravom možemo govoriti o izdavačkom pothvatu. "PJ Masks" prikazuje uzbudljive noćne pothvate troje mladih prijatelja koji se s mrakom, odnosno navlačenjem svojih pidžama i aktivacijom svojih životinjskih amajlija, transformiraju u svoja superjunačka alter ega, Catboya, Owlette i Gekka. Tako opremljeni, zajedno se upuštaju u akcijske pustolovine, rješavaju zagonetke i pritom usvajaju vrijedne životne pouke.
